name: Onesteel Rend
description: Cut with the one edge in a single stroke that rends guard and body without a second blow.

name: Onesteel Aegis
description: Hold the one blade before the body as a guard that takes every blow on a single point of qi.

name: Onesteel Lance
description: Gather the whole sword into the point and loose one lance that pierces without slowing.

name: Onesteel Sweep
description: Swing the one edge in a full ring that cuts every foe within the stroke.

name: Onesteel Apex
description: Cut with the one edge so the stroke lands and presses down the target's qi.

name: Onesteel Passage
description: Pass the single blade through the guard as though it were not there and cut from beyond.

name: Onesteel Reprisal
description: Take a great blow on the one edge and send its full force back through the striker.

name: Onesteel Dominion
description: Cut a great ring with the one sword that strikes all in reach and bows their qi.

name: Onesteel Verdict
description: The canon's great form: one stroke of judgment with the one edge whose weight rises with skill.

name: Onesteel Sunder
description: The canon's second great form: a single plain cut that sunders all that it meets and grows with the wielder's skill.

name: Lastline Edge
description: Draw the last line of the sword and destroy all within its reach up to the destructive ceiling of the wielder's tier.

name: Edgeless Edge
description: Cut where no blade has passed so the target is found already cut at every point the sword could reach however guarded.

name: Originsteel Rend
description: Cut with the edge that every other edge descends from and rend whatever it meets.

name: Originsteel Aegis
description: Hold a guard of the first blade that no later blade can break through.

name: Originsteel Lance
description: Gather the first sword into the point and loose a lance that pierces any guard.

name: Originsteel Sweep
description: Swing the origin blade in a great ring that cuts every foe in the stroke.

name: Originsteel Apex
description: Cut with the first edge so the stroke lands and presses down the target's qi.

name: Originsteel Passage
description: Pass the origin blade through every guard as if none had been raised and cut from beyond.

name: Originsteel Reprisal
description: Take any blow on the first edge and send its full force back through the striker.

name: Originsteel Dominion
description: Cut a great ring with the first sword that strikes all in reach and bows their qi.

name: Originsteel Verdict
description: The treatise's great form: one stroke of judgment with the first edge whose weight rises with skill.

name: Originsteel Sunder
description: The treatise's second great form: a plain cut that sunders all it meets and grows with the wielder's skill.

name: Originsteel Judgment
description: The treatise's third great form: one stroke that cuts and guards as judgment and rises with skill.

name: Bladeless Ruin
description: Bring a ruin without a blade that destroys all within the destructive ceiling of the wielder's divine tier.

name: Ruin Sovereign
description: Rule over a final ruin that breaks all within the ceiling of the wielder's tier and bows the survivors.

name: Sword Beyond Swords
description: Call the sword every sword descends from so each blade the target holds yields and the cut already stands as done.

name: Unsheathed Origin
description: Cut the very notion of defense from the target for one breath so no guard it holds or ever held can stand.
